gsang ba sngags kyi rgyal po dbal gshen che mchog mngon du rol pa yang gsang thugs kyi rgyud
item.coloph: dbal che mchog mngon du rol pa/ yang gsang thugs kyi rgyud ces bya ba/ le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa 'di ni/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar nas/ rgyud pa rim pa bzhin du brgyud nas/ stang chen dmu tsa gyer med kyis/ sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po la snyan du brgyud pa'o/ sprul sku de nyid kyi drung nas/ rgo (sgo) rigs sgrub gshen rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyis zhus so/ rgyud 'dzin bla ma de nyid kyi drung nas/ 'gru rigs sngags 'chang / she tsu khi khar gyis/ dbang bzhi rjes gnang dang*/ bcas pa zhus so/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug bstan pa'i don du/ bka' brgyud gtan la phab nas yi ger bris pa 'di/ 'gro ba'i don du dar zhing rgyas 'gyur cig/

item.tib: gsang ba sngags kyi rgyal po dbal gshen che mchog mngon du rol pa yang gsang thugs kyi rgyud
